Zero Defects Promise

Quality Assurance & Material Traceability

We protect B2B client integrity using certified spectrometer inspection and heat-code barcoding audits.

🧪

Spectrometer Chemistry

GNR Italy optical emission spectrometers check alloy contents. Zero billing is approved without chemical conformity logs.

🔍

100% MPI Crack Audits

Magnetic particle inspection (MPI) filters out any micro-voids, boundary folds, or internal fissures on high-stress components.

⛓️

Heat Code laser stamping

Each component receives a laser-stamped batch heat number, linking raw material chemical certificates to the final product shipment.
